text:
To mark a temperature scale on a thermometer, fixed points are needed.
Which is a fixed point?
A
the bottom end of the thermometer tube
B
the top end of the thermometer tube
C
the temperature of pure melting ice
D
the temperature of pure warm water

options.label: A
options.text: the bottom end of the thermometer tube

options.label: B
options.text: the top end of the thermometer tube

options.label: C
options.text: the temperature of pure melting ice

options.label: D
options.text: the temperature of pure warm water
